ontology.note: PROV comparison consumes source and optional explicit Mean center entities, with matched UTM CRS and counts; GeoSPARQL center geometry and QUDT metre quantities.

changes.description: Hands on a table of what it found, in metres: how far the mean centre moved, each mean centre's distance to its nearest pump with the pump named, and how far a point moved, least, median and most. Comparison map, which read its result, retired into Map and a Table (docs/audits/comparison-map-retired.md). On the standard (experiment 186): its Inspector moves to point-comparison-ui.ts, the UTM zone into Configure…, and its Result says how far the mean centre moved.

evidence.note: Projection, count, display and SHACL checks; no privacy guarantee or independent scientific certification.
